title: Lean Finder V2: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Disambiguates User Queries
abstract: arXiv:2610.30843v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce Lean Finder V2, a semantic search framework for Mathlib that disambiguates user queries through complementary model-level adversarial training and input-level query rewriting. Human mathematicians and coding agents rarely search Mathlib by providing detailed context. In practice, they query short properties, notation, aliases, or hypotheses, leaving much of the intended mathematics implicit. In contrast, existing Mathlib search engines unrealistically assume context-rich queries. The scarcity of real-world short queries paired with ground-truth Mathlib statements makes this ambiguity even more intractable. We argue that this is essentially a data problem. Through adversarial training, we scale up the generation of labeled short and ambiguous queries, and learn to disambiguate user queries at both model-level fine-tuning and input-level query rewriting. translated_title: Lean Finder V2：为 Mathlib 提供可消除用户查询歧义的语义搜索
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 Lean Finder V2，这是一个面向 Mathlib 的语义搜索框架，通过互补的模型级对抗训练和输入级查询重写来消除用户查询的歧义。人类数学家和编码智能体很少通过提供详细上下文来搜索 Mathlib。在实践中，他们查询的是简短的性质、记号、别名或假设，而将大部分预期的数学内容隐含在查询之外。相比之下，现有的 Mathlib 搜索引擎不切实际地假设查询带有丰富的上下文。由于缺乏与真实标准（ground-truth）Mathlib 陈述配对的真实世界短查询，这种歧义问题变得更加难以处理。我们认为这本质上是一个数据问题。通过对抗训练，我们扩大了带标注的短且含歧义查询的生成规模，并在模型级微调和输入级查询重写两个层面上学习消除用户查询的歧义。在人工策划的 MathlibQR 基准测试上，我们的 Lean Finder V2 创造了新的最佳纪录（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: Lean Finder V2 通过互补的模型级对抗训练与输入级查询重写，实现了能够消除歧义的 Mathlib 语义搜索，有效解决了短而模糊查询的检索难题。
en_tdlr: Lean Finder V2 achieves disambiguated semantic search for Mathlib through complementary model-level adversarial training and input-level query rewriting, effectively addressing the challenge of retrieving results for short and ambiguous queries.
